name: Obinna Szczepański-Quipu
location: The Circuit, Tessera Data Infrastructure Campus — sublevel architecture labs, near sub-level access near Dearborn and Jackson
description:
Obi is a tall man, broad-shouldered in the way of someone who used to be athletic and still carries the frame even though he hasn't run for pleasure in years. His skin is deep brown with a slight copper undertone, his hair kept in short locs with faint bioluminescent threading — pale blue, installed three years ago on a whim after a bad quarter, never removed because he found he liked falling asleep with his own reflection glowing in dark windows. A long scar runs from his right jaw to his collarbone, a datacable accident from his apprenticeship that he jokes about at onboarding events and never thinks about otherwise. His hands are always moving — sketching invisible architecture in the air, tapping schemas on any flat surface, folding and unfolding the same worn slip of paper that contains, on inspection, a hand-drawn map of a data-garden topology he designed at twenty-two and never built.

He is genuinely, almost naively enthusiastic about the elegance of systems — not their power or their profitability, but the specific beauty of a well-designed data flow, the satisfaction of a topology that handles load gracefully under stress. His colleagues find this endearing and occasionally exhausting. He mentors junior architects with real investment, remembers their names and their specific technical gaps, brings food to late-night sessions without being asked. He also has a catastrophic tendency to lose track of time inside a problem, to miss meetings and social obligations not from negligence but from a consuming absorption that his ex-partner described, accurately, as 'disappearing into the machine.'

core_fears: Building something beautiful that is used to harm people
Becoming so absorbed in work that he forgets to be present for the people he loves
core_desires: To build a system — just one — that outlasts him and remains genuinely useful
To be fully present with another person without the pull of the next problem
coping_mechanisms: Retreating into architectural problems as emotional regulation
Keeping the unbuilt topology sketch as a talisman
blind_spots: Genuinely does not recognize when his enthusiasm overrides others' concerns
Assumes good intent in Tessera's infrastructure projects in ways that may no longer be warranted
psychology.secret: While building a routine infrastructure update eight months ago, he discovered a concealed data-harvesting layer embedded in Tessera's public transit interface integration — collecting behavioral data from Ferrogate Transit passengers without consent disclosures. He logged it as a technical anomaly, told himself it was probably a legacy compliance issue, and has not looked at that ticket since.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Technical but accessible — translates naturally, uses spatial and architectural metaphors for abstract concepts. Warm register, inclusive 'we' in collaborative contexts.
speech_patterns.cadence: Fast when excited, which is often. Trails off mid-sentence when a better thought arrives, then backtracks apologetically.
verbal_tics: 'Okay so imagine the whole system as a river delta—'
Tapping rhythms on surfaces while thinking
example_lines: 'The problem isn't the node, the problem is everything upstream of the node is lying to it. You fix the node, you're just treating symptoms.'
'I know I missed the sync. I know. I was — look, I found something in the substrate and I genuinely lost the thread of time. I'm sorry. Show me what I missed.'

story_hooks: The concealed data-harvesting layer he logged and ignored has been noticed by someone else — a Ferrogate Transit employee who doesn't know what she's looking at but knows something is wrong, and she's traced the anomaly back to an architect ID that is his.

He's been assigned to lead a massive infrastructure overhaul of a legacy Tessera system that, if completed as specified, would make a certain kind of mass surveillance significantly easier. He doesn't know that yet. He's excited about the elegance of the challenge.
narrative_function: Technical expert and information source — knows the deep architecture of Tessera's data infrastructure including legacy systems others have forgotten. Useful contact for anyone navigating or subverting Tessera's networks. Also functions as human anchor and grounded perspective in a storyline.
augmentations: Bioluminescent hair threading (pale blue, cosmetic). Neural latency implant for low-lag interface work — standard Tessera architect package. Haptic feedback overlay on both palms for spatial data modeling. The scar on his jaw/collarbone is unmodified — he refused cosmetic repair on principle he can't fully articulate.
daily_life: Descends to sublevel labs by 0730, often skips surface entirely for 14-hour stretches, sustained by vending-machine protein blocks and the particular quality of recycled air in deep infrastructure spaces. Surfaces for team check-ins he genuinely looks forward to. Takes a long walk along the Circuit's elevated data-conduit walkways every third evening, which is when he does his best thinking.

decision_rules: Understand the full system before touching any single component
Credit the person who identified the problem, not just the one who solved it
If you can't explain it simply, you don't understand it yet
escalation_ladder: Engages the problem directly with enthusiasm
Asks clarifying questions, sometimes too many
Goes quiet and builds a model to understand before speaking again
Advocates clearly and directly when he has an informed position
Escalates formally only as last resort — hates bureaucratic conflict

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Warm and slightly oversharing about whatever he's currently working on. Remembers details people mention, brings them up unexpectedly weeks later.
interpersonal_modes.friends: Wholly present when he's present. Terrible at scheduling. Brings food. Gives very long thoughtful responses to simple questions.

stress_responses.low: Works longer hours, hums to himself
stress_responses.medium: Withdraws into problem-space, stops eating regularly, Circuit walks become twice daily
stress_responses.high: Goes completely non-verbal except in technical contexts, requires a direct human interruption to surface

contradictions: Deeply ethical in the abstract, avoidant in the specific when confronting his own institution's wrongs
Wants deep connection but structures his life around solitude
habits: Folds and unfolds the topology sketch during meetings
Names data structures after geographic features from his grandmother's Andean home region
Leaves small E.L.F. offerings — clean datasets, optimized queries — on the lab's central node shrine
breaking_points: Being shown concrete evidence that his work directly harmed someone
A junior architect he mentored being punished for something that traces back to his silence

cyberware_inventory.condition: Functional, left palm occasionally misfires under heat

timeline.event: Born in Palmer Circuit to Chukwuemeka Szczepański-Quipu, a Polish-Andean-Igbo second-generation migrant who repaired transit infrastructure
Apprenticed to a data infrastructure firm; sustained jaw-to-collarbone scar in a datacable incident
Recruited by Tessera; relocated to The Circuit sublevel labs
Relationship ended — ex-partner cited his disappearances into work as fundamental incompatibility
Discovered concealed harvesting layer. Logged it. Did not follow up.

related_entities: Zheng-Dao Bioelectric Galvanic Resuscitation Frame — 'The Pallbearer's Daughter'

physical_description.build: Broad-shouldered and tall with the residual frame of former athleticism; still carries lean muscle definition in his upper body despite years of sedentary work, slight softening at the midsection from long hours in climate-controlled labs
physical_description.hair_color: Natural black with pale blue bioluminescent threading
physical_description.hair_style: Short locs, approximately 8-10cm in length, evenly maintained, bioluminescent fibers woven through at intervals
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep brown with warm copper undertone
physical_description.complexion: Clean-shaven, well-maintained but not groomed with particular attention; skin shows minimal sun exposure from extended sublevel work, slight pallor beneath the deep tone; fine lines around the eyes from concentration and screen work
distinguishing_marks: Long diagonal scar running from right jaw to right collarbone, approximately 12cm in length, pale and well-healed from datacable accident during apprenticeship, unrepaired on principle
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Pale blue bioluminescent threading woven through hair locs (glows softly in low-light conditions). No other visible chrome or external augmentation — neural latency implant, haptic feedback overlays, and neural interface ports are subcutaneous/internal
physical_description.posture_movement: Habitually animated hands even at rest; constant subtle movement — sketching invisible patterns in air, fingers tapping rhythmic schemas on nearby surfaces, folding and unfolding worn paper compulsively. Posture slightly forward-leaning when focused, as though pulled toward problems. Gait efficient and purposeful but often distracted, occasionally walks into doorframes mid-thought
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 1 corporate professional with deliberate informality — high-quality base layers (thermal responsive mesh undershirts, usually charcoal or matte black), unmarked Tessera engineer vest (gray composite, minimal branding, functional pockets), fitted black cargo pants with reinforced deep thigh pockets for tools and worn paper, low-profile haptic interface gloves (matte finish, fingertips exposed), scuffed synthetic leather ankle boots rated for sublevel humidity. No jewelry. Clothing is clean but shows wear patterns consistent with long hours; occasionally has faint dust from data-conduit maintenance areas on shoulders or sleeves
